items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.contentSnippet:

There's something about the pixelated detections from images coming off the satellite.. I discussed the build in another post: https://fmsg.ai/blog/agent-swarm-ufo-optix

items.title: Show HN: CheckMyApp – checks your live app with each deploy from coding agent
items.contentSnippet:
No human in the loop is the new dream.
CheckMyApp is the first half of the loop I believe every solo founder should have. It clicks through your changes in production (or PR preview urls if you like) and files tickets with screenshots of bugs. Hook those tickets to claude/codex and the loop closes.
I've tasted agentic coding and I'm not going back. I have more ideas than I can count and all of them are stuck behind one slow guy checking if the app is working and billing is indeed fine.
